resources.string: Cannot connect to the Linux component. Check that it is installed, enabled and matches this Floe version. Reopen Floe and retry; if it repeats, send the diagnostic details.
The download server rejected the request or is unavailable. Check the HTTP code in diagnostics. Try later or another network; if it repeats, send those details.
Not enough storage to prepare Linux. Free some internal storage, then try again. Existing files are preserved.
The download address could not be resolved. Check DNS, Wi-Fi or your VPN, then try again.
The connection timed out. Try a stable network, then prepare again.
Secure connection failed. Check the device date and your network or VPN.
The environment could not be downloaded. Check network access, try another network and retry.
The downloaded environment is incomplete, damaged or incompatible with its catalog. Retry on a stable network; if it repeats, send the diagnostic details.
Android blocked the operation. Check notifications and the permission to install apps from Floe, then continue.
Component installation was cancelled. Tap Prepare when you are ready, then confirm in the Android installer.
Android rejected this component version. Update Floe and its Linux component together, then retry.
Linux still has active work. Stop its terminals or services, then prepare again.
Preparation failed. Open the diagnostic details to identify the stage and error. Retry once; if it repeats, include those details in feedback.
